cards.title: Seven Black Ships
cards.text: While in the Rear, this Subject has +1 Strength.

cards.title: Those Who Came Back
cards.text: This Subject has +1 Strength while your discard pile contains at least five cards.

cards.title: The House at Orra
cards.text: This Subject has +1 Strength while an adjacent position contains a complete Legend.

cards.title: The Children of the Salt Road
cards.text: When you attach a Link here, this Subject gains +1 Strength until the end of the Battle.

cards.title: Followed
cards.text: While complete, its Subject has +3 Strength.

cards.title: Swore To
cards.text: While complete, its Subject has +5 Strength. If the Name leaves this Legend, discard the Subject.

cards.title: Defied
cards.text: While complete, its Subject has +2 Strength and the opposing Front has -2 Strength.

cards.title: Carried
cards.text: While complete, its Subject has +2 Strength. Its Name cannot be returned to hand by a Plot.

cards.title: Avenged
cards.text: While complete, its Subject has +1 Strength for each of your cards discarded this Battle, to a maximum of +4.

cards.title: Namar
cards.text: If Namar completes Followed, that Subject gains +2 additional Strength.

cards.title: Iria
cards.text: When Iria completes a Legend, you may move that Legend to an adjacent legal position.

cards.title: Teyra
cards.text: When Teyra completes a Legend, reveal one enemy Scheme in this Front.

cards.title: He Never Came
cards.text: Return one Name to its owner's hand.

cards.title: They Chose Another
cards.text: Move one of your Names to another legal open Link you control.
